alert_news.title: Anantnag becomes India's first district to complete 157,860 Digital Holistic Progress Cards
bullets: Anantnag district, Kashmir, first district in India to complete 157,860 Digital Holistic Progress Cards covering 1,444 government and private schools.

Initiated in May 2025 by DIET Anantnag under the Ministry of Education’s PARAKH portal, the programme was fully implemented by November 2026, marking a nationwide shift to competency‑based learning and holistic assessment.

alert_news.title: Wayanad Becomes India’s First E‑Waste‑Free District
bullets: Wayanad district, Kerala, will be officially declared the first e‑waste‑free district in India on 27 Nov 2026
Achieved by collecting 97.26 metric tonnes of e‑waste during a district‑wide drive coordinated by the Suchitwa Mission and Clean Kerala Company

alert_news.title: Assam Discovers India’s First New Sedge Moth Species in a Century
bullets: Glyphipterix brevimucronata, the first new sedge moth species recorded in India in nearly 100 years, discovered near Hollongapar Gibbon Sanctuary, Jorhat district, Assam
Described by ICAR‑IARI scientist Kishore Chandra Sahoo and published in the journal Zootaxa

alert_news.title: Mumbai Launches AI System to Screen Building-Permit Proposals
bullets: India’s first AI-powered construction and building-permission system, CivitTwin, launched by Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) in Mumbai.
CivitTwin conducts virtual pre‑scrutiny of building proposals, flagging missing documents and regulatory violations to reduce delays and improve transparency.

alert_news.title: Shivraj Chouhan unveils India's first homegrown bird flu vaccine
bullets: India’s first indigenous H5N1 bird flu vaccine, developed by ICAR‑NIHSAD in Bhopal, was dedicated by Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
The vaccine enables protection of the poultry sector and marks a milestone in animal health, with a BSL‑4 laboratory to be established at the institute.

alert_news.title: Karnataka to set up India's first govt sports technology centre with Amagi in Bengaluru
bullets: India's first government Sports Technology Centre of Excellence (CoE) to be established in Bengaluru by Karnataka in partnership with Amagi Media Labs.
Centre will focus on sports analytics, deep tech, biomechanics, athlete development and cross‑cutting ecosystem enablers.
Karnataka state government will provide seed funding and infrastructure; operations run by industry professionals.

alert_news.title: Gaganyaan's first uncrewed launch pushed to February 2027: Report
bullets: Gaganyaan, India's first human spaceflight program, will conduct its first uncrewed orbital flight (G1) carrying the Vyommitra humanoid robot.
The launch will test the human‑rated LVM3 launch vehicle, crew module, life‑support systems and recovery mechanisms.
Program approved in January 2019; first crewed flight target May 2022; uncrewed launch now scheduled for February 2027.

alert_news.title: India to unveil indigenous H5N1 poultry vaccine - Telangana Today
bullets: India's first indigenous inactivated H5N1 bird flu vaccine for poultry developed by ICAR‑NIHSAD in Bhopal.
Vaccine targets the HPAI H5N1 strain, aiming to reduce poultry mortality and economic losses from outbreaks.
Developed by Indian Council of Agricultural Research – National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases.

alert_news.title: India's First Government-led Microdrama Series on Scam Awareness Launched
bullets: First government‑led microdrama series on online scam awareness, launched by the Ministry of Information & Broadcasting, Prasar Bharati, SEBI, and I4C.
Series to air on Instagram and Waves OTT, educating the public on common digital scams and promoting the cyber‑crime helpline 1930.

alert_news.title: India's First Hydrogen Production Facility Using Steel Plant Off‑Gases Planned
bullets: India’s first hydrogen production plant using steel‑plant off‑gases, to be built at Tata Steel’s Kalinganagar integrated steelworks in Odisha.
Projected capacity of 10 tonnes of high‑purity hydrogen per day using H2Gen technology to support decarbonisation.

alert_news.title: Gaganyaan Mission Launch Sriharikota; Indian Astronauts Travel March 2028
bullets: India’s first human space mission, Gaganyaan, to be launched from Sriharikota using the human‑rated LVM3 (HLVM3) rocket
First crewed flight scheduled for March 2028, marking India as the fourth country to send humans into space
